description: Extend the React SPA to show live order status and the 10 most recent orders, consuming the FEAT-001 API. Keep the coffee theme, header + version badge, the architecture <details> section, and the activity log. On a successful POST /order, poll GET /order/{id} every ~3-4s and render a status badge RECEIVED -> BREWING -> READY (stop polling at READY), with three visually distinct badge styles. Add a 'Recent orders (latest 10)' card that calls GET /orders on load, after each placed order, and via a manual Refresh button (columns: Placed(time), Order ID, Items/Total, Points, Status badge). Update the 'AWS services in this demo' copy to say DynamoDB stores orders and SSM supplies the loyalty rate. All fetches stay same-origin relative. Depends on FEAT-001 for the response shapes (read FEAT-001.findings).
steps: Read .agents/tasks/plan.md, .agents/tasks/context.json, and .agents/tasks/features/FEAT-001.json (its findings give the exact response field names) FIRST.

Edit /Users/erictole/demo/apcr-dva/.worktrees/realapp/demo/session4-coffee-ship/container/frontend/src/App.jsx: keep MENU, cart +/- qty, running total, Place order, the activity log, the version badge from GET /health, and the architecture <details> block. Send POST /order with {items:[{id,name,qty,price}],total} built from the cart (items carry name+qty+price; total is the rounded sum).

On POST success, read {orderId,status} from the response and start polling GET /order/{orderId} every ~3-4s via setInterval; update a current-order status badge; clear the interval when status === 'READY' (and on unmount). Log transitions to the activity log.

Add a 'Recent orders (latest 10)' card: fetch GET /orders on initial load (useEffect), again after each placed order, and from a manual Refresh button. Render a table/list with columns Placed(time, from createdAt), Order ID, Items/Total, Points, Status badge. Handle the empty state and a fetch error (log to the activity log, do not crash the UI).
Update the SERVICES list copy so DynamoDB reads 'stores orders' and SSM Parameter Store reads 'supplies the loyalty rate' (keep the other entries).
Keep ALL API calls same-origin relative (/order, /orders, /order/{id}, /health) - no base URL, no CORS.

Edit /Users/erictole/demo/apcr-dva/.worktrees/realapp/demo/session4-coffee-ship/container/frontend/src/styles.css: add three distinct status-badge styles (RECEIVED, BREWING, READY) and recent-orders table styling using the existing coffee theme CSS variables; keep it responsive.
Verify the SPA builds (npm run build).
Commit locally on branch coffee-ship-realapp. NEVER push.
Set this FEAT status to completed; note anything FEAT-004 docs should mention about the UI in findings.

App.jsx polls GET /order/{id} after a placed order and stops at READY; a visible status badge reflects RECEIVED/BREWING/READY.
A 'Recent orders (latest 10)' card calls GET /orders on load, after each order, and via a Refresh button, rendering Placed/Order ID/Items-Total/Points/Status columns.
All API calls are same-origin relative paths (no absolute http URL, no CORS headers requested).
styles.css defines three distinct status-badge styles consistent with the coffee theme; the header, version badge, activity log, and architecture <details> are retained.

findings: Extended container/frontend/src/App.jsx and styles.css. POST /order now sends {items:[{id,name,qty,price}],total} built from the cart (only items with qty>0; total = Number(total.toFixed(2))). On success it reads {orderId,status,points,total,createdAt}, shows a current-order panel with a StatusBadge, and polls GET /order/{orderId} every 3.5s via setInterval (pollRef useRef); clears the interval when status==='READY' and on unmount, and logs each transition. Added a 'Recent orders (latest 10)' card fed by GET /orders on mount (useEffect), after each placed order, after each status transition, and via a Refresh button; columns Placed(fmtTime from createdAt epoch seconds)/Order ID/Items-Total/Points/Status badge, with empty-state and fetch-error handling that logs and does not crash. All fetches are same-origin relative (/health, /order, /orders, /order/{id}). SERVICES copy updated: DynamoDB 'stores orders', SSM Parameter Store 'supplies the loyalty rate'. styles.css adds three distinct .status-badge styles (.received accent, .brewing warn, .ready ok), a .current-order panel, and .recent-table styling (horizontal scroll on narrow screens) using the coffee-theme CSS vars. Note for FEAT-004 docs: order status derives on the server from createdAt (RECEIVED <10s, BREWING 10-25s, READY >=25s), so the UI badge advances on its own over ~25s while polling; the Recent orders table shows the latest 10 newest-first and has a manual Refresh button. Items/Total column shows item count + total since the POST response does not echo items but GET /order and GET /orders do. Verified: npm install && npm run build exits 0 (dist/index.html + dist/assets/* produced); grep '/orders' present in App.jsx; runtime curl GET / against the built dist returns 200 text/html.
